tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Extract the transcript of a YouTube video or Shorts link. Returns clean text (optionally with timestamps) and paginates long transcripts automatically. Uses the authenticated account's transcript allowance (free accounts include 2 transcripts/day).

tools.name: get_transcript_status
tools.description: Fetch the status or next paginated chunk of a previously submitted transcript request by requestId.

tools.name: list_playlist_videos
tools.description: List public video IDs, titles, durations, and URLs from a YouTube playlist URL (up to 50 videos per call).
